title: Cold Exposure in Murine Models
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kbbcsin
materials: Determine blood glucose levels on a drop of blood taken from the nicked tail of a free-moving mouse using the Accu-Chek Aviva glucose meter (06988563016, Roche Diagnostics) and Accu-Chek Aviva glucose strips (06453970, Roche Diagnostics)
Process the portions for histology (see separate protocol).

steps.title: Measure initial body weight
steps.instruction: Determine the body weight of 8‑week‑old male mice (C57BL/6J, C57BL/6N or gene‑deficient mice with control littermates).

steps.title: House mice individually
steps.instruction: House the mice individually with ad libitum access to standard chow (10.9 kJ/g) and drinking water.

steps.title: Expose mice to cold
steps.instruction: Transfer cages to a ventilated cooling unit (Friginox, France) set at 4–8 °C for either 72 hours or 2 weeks, maintaining a 12‑hour light/dark cycle (7 AM/7 PM).

steps.title: Refresh water, chow, monitor health
steps.instruction: Replace drinking water and change cages with fresh standard chow bi‑weekly; check animal health daily.

steps.title: Record intake and temperature
steps.instruction: Upon each cage change, record food intake, body weight, and body temperature using a rectal probe (TR‑100, Fine Science Tools).

steps.title: Fast animals
steps.instruction: After the 72‑hour or 2‑week cold exposure, fast animals for 6 hours (7:30 AM–1:30 PM).

steps.title: Euthanize with pentobarbital or Dolethal
steps.instruction: Prepare intraperitoneal injection of sodium pentobarbital at 60 mg/kg (dilute 60 mg/ml stock 10× with saline) or Dolethal at 200 mg/kg (dilute 200 mg/ml stock 30× with saline); inject the calculated volume.

steps.title: Collect retro‑orbital blood
steps.instruction: While the animal is anesthetized, collect blood from the retro‑orbital sinus into trisodium citrate, process for plasma, and store aliquots at –80 °C.

steps.title: Perfuse circulatory system
steps.instruction: Immobilize the animal, make a small cut in the right atrium, insert a perfusion needle into the left‑ventricular apex, and wash out the heart and entire circulatory system with saline (use Microflex Infusion set, orange, Ref. 240.05, Vygon Vet).

steps.title: Incise skin to expose sWAT
steps.instruction: Make a midline skin incision and an additional incision at the hind‑limb level; pull skin laterally to reveal inguinal subcutaneous white adipose tissue (sWAT), remove internal lymph nodes, and dissect out the sWAT depots.

substeps.instruction: Make midline skin incision and hind‑limb incision
Pull skin aside to expose sWAT

steps.title: Open abdominal cavity
steps.instruction: Make a midline incision in the muscle layer to open the abdominal cavity.

steps.title: Harvest GON WAT and liver
steps.instruction: Locate intra‑abdominal gonadal (GON) white adipose tissue depots and liver; remove them.

steps.title: Harvest interscapular BAT
steps.instruction: Flip the mouse, locate the interscapular brown adipose tissue depot, and remove it.

steps.title: Portion tissues
steps.instruction: Divide each harvested tissue into portions for RNA, protein extraction, or histology.

steps.title: Snap‑freeze tissue samples
steps.instruction: Snap‑freeze the portions intended for RNA and protein extraction and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Sanitize bench and tools
steps.instruction: Clean dissection material and bench with Virkon S (5 O tablets/bottle, Fisher Scientific catalog #NC9821357), detergent, water, and 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dispose of animal carcass
steps.instruction: Dispose of the animal body according to internal institutional guidelines.
